Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And do not make your hand shackled to your neck, nor extend it completely, lest you sit blameworthy and regretful.' He said: 'Al-ih'sar is poverty/destitution.'
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'al-ih'sar' mean in the context of Quranic generosity?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the Quranic verse (17:29) by defining 'al-ih'sar' as destitution, thereby linking excessive stinginess directly to financial lack. This interpretation underscores the Shia scholarly view that miserliness is not merely a moral failing but a practical cause of poverty, balancing the extremes of hoarding and reckless spending.
